newsitem.title: UK: Britain announces 10 pct income tax rate.
newsitem.headline: Britain announces 10 pct income tax rate.

text.p: British finance minister Gordon Brown said on Wednesday he would introduce a 10 percent tax rate on personal income as soon as it was prudent.
At present the lowest (threshold) tax rate is 20 percent while most people pay a 23 percent basic tax rate.
"We will introduce a 10 pence rate of income tax as soon as it is prudent to do so," Brown told parliament during his budget speech.
Brown said he would leave other personal income tax rates unchanged.

In other measures expected to have a direct impact on individuals, he said he would raise duties on alcoholic drinks by the rate of inflation, pending a thorough-going review into the smuggling of alcohol from European Union countries where tax rates are lower, while tobacco prices would rise by two percent.
Brown also fulfilled his party's election pledge to reduce consumer tax on home heating fuel to five percent from eight percent.
